svg.aria-label: Upload throughput, one client: higher is better
svg.title: Upload throughput, one client: higher is better
svg.text: Upload throughput, one client: higher is better
One warm client POSTs a body to the Go server (net/http, quic-go) over each protocol; MB/s is request body megabytes (10^6)
per second, every body checked against the length the server read. In each panel the clients are sorted best first; under
it, mimicry against the best of the other impersonating clients.
net/http, Go's standard client, as the reference
POST 64 KB, one request at a time
mimicry keeps Chrome's 6 connections per host
POST 10 MB, one request at a time
mimicry keeps Chrome's 6 connections per host
The Go server was the limit here, not the
Linux host (Intel Core i5-13500), 20 cores, Linux 6.18.38; the client on 4 CPUs (GOMAXPROCS 4); nginx/1.31.8.
